'''2014 US Nationals Day 1 Kendall Halman LS You Can Either Profit By This…''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kendall Halman]] at [[2014 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[You Can Either Profit By This… / Or Be Destroyed]]
* '''Username:''' Corran
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
